pretreatments.description: Heat treatment: The waste activated sludge was heated at 102 °C for approximately 30 min to become the heat-treated sludge. This action ruptures the cell wall and membrane of bacteria, releasing complex organic molecules and activating the sludge for hydrolysis while inactivating methanogens.

Alkali pretreatment: The digestion medium was adjusted to pH 10 using 4 M NaOH. This condition significantly enhanced the hydrolysis and acidification of the sludge while suppressing the methanogenic activity of the methanogens due to the narrow pH range required for their growth.
